name: stump of a thick ship mast with a sawn round top face, iron rings, standing in a round wedged deck collar, all seen from above at 3/4

answer.main_body: stump of a thick ship mast with collar
answer.evidence: The sawn circular top of the mast stump is clearly rendered as a foreshortened ellipse spanning rows 1-4, with curved iron bands and deck collar below confirming the 3/4 perspective.

answer.main_body: mast stump with sawn top face and deck collar
answer.evidence: The sawn circular top of the mast stump is clearly rendered as a foreshortened elliptical surface across rows 1-3, with the cylindrical body, iron bands, and collar descending below.

The sawn cut face of the mast stump is clearly drawn from above spanning rows 1 to 3 with lighter cross-section wood tones, leading into the vertical cylinder with iron bands and the deck collar below.

The sawn top surface of the mast stump is rendered as a foreshortened elliptical face spanning rows 2 to 4 (approx. 3 rows tall), showing proper 3/4 perspective above the banded cylindrical trunk and deck collar.
